test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the idioms and phrases underlined in the given sentence.

You can best identify the __fair weather friends__ at the time of adversity.

options.text: Friends who come in good weather conditions
Friend only at the time of prosperity

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"fair weather friends"** refers to people **who are only your friends during good times and abandon you in times of trouble**. (सुख के साथी)

 
 
• **Example: **When he lost his job, he realized that most of his so-called friends were just** fair weather friends.**
 
 
 
• **"Adversity"** refers to a difficult or unpleasant situation. (विपत्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **True friends stand by you in times of **adversity.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Friends who bring good rain** (अच्छी बारिश लाने वाले दोस्त): This option is incorrect as it is a literal interpretation and does not fit the idiom’s meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** This is not a correct interpretation of the idiom "fair weather friends".
 
 
 
• **Friends who come in good weather conditions** (अच्छे मौसम की स्थिति में आने वाले दोस्त): This option is also incorrect as it misinterprets the idiom.
 
 
• **Example:** This does not accurately describe the meaning of "fair weather friends".
 
 
 
• **Best friends** (सबसे अच्छे दोस्त): This option is incorrect as it does not relate to the conditional nature of "fair weather friends".
 
 
• **Example:** Best friends are different from fair weather friends as they support you in all situations.
 
 

41:Tc45,

The correct answer is **Option 3.**
